# tools: install ngrok through cask, not manual

Replace the hand-rolled ngrok download in the `Makefile` (`install-ngrok`, an `equinox.io` zip identified by a hash, [[DOT-130]], [[DOT-341]]) with the [`ngrok` cask](https://formulae.brew.sh/cask/ngrok). **Motivation:** "for better updates" — `brew cu` upgrades the cask, whereas the Makefile target only installed when the binary was missing and never upgraded it.
